look_here_first: Small unarmed black nightshade with white star flowers and shiny black berries whose calyx lobes strongly reflex away from the mature fruit.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Solanaceae/Solanum: alternate leaves, 5-parted rotate or star-shaped corollas, poricidal anthers, and berry fruits; prickles and stellate hairs occur in many species.
best_field_traits: calyx lobes strongly reflexed in fruit
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Only unarmed black-berried species in B106. Do not confuse it with the prickly horsenettles or yellow-flowered buffalobur.
